AWAKE.Title: Awake — Unofficial Don't Rest Your Head System

Validation.FightCheckedExceedsTotal: Checked Fight responses cannot exceed total Fight responses.
Validation.FlightCheckedExceedsTotal: Checked Flight responses cannot exceed total Flight responses.
Validation.ResponseAllocation: Fight and Flight totals must allocate exactly zero or three responses.
Validation.DisciplineMadnessTotal: Discipline and Permanent Madness must always add up to three.

Scars.TransformWarning: A transformed Scar is permanently crossed out and can never be recalled or transformed again.
Scars.TransformReminder: When you transform a Scar, choose one: change your Madness Talent, change your Exhaustion Talent, or gain the equivalent of 5 Hope.

ExhaustionTalent.MinorUseText: Your Degree cannot be lower than your current Exhaustion.
ExhaustionTalent.MajorUseText: Increase Exhaustion by 1, then add your current Exhaustion to the Degree.

Hope.SpendPlaceholder: Hope spending options will be available here.
Hope.SpendDescription: Each Hope coin adds a 1 to the protagonist's Discipline pool.
Hope.InvalidAmount: Choose at least one Hope coin.
Hope.NotEnough: There is not enough Hope in the Chalice.

Conflict.Title: Conflict
Conflict.GMOnly: Only the GM can start a conflict.
Conflict.InvalidActor: The selected protagonist could not be found.
Conflict.InvalidPain: Pain must be a whole number of at least 1.
Conflict.NotYourProtagonist: You do not own this protagonist.
Conflict.InvalidTemporaryMadness: Temporary Madness must be a whole number from 0 to 6.
Conflict.InvalidConflict: The conflict could not be found.
Conflict.AlreadyRolled: This conflict has already been rolled.
Conflict.NoActiveGM: No active GM is available to receive the conflict roll.

Chalices.Title: Hope and Despair Chalices
Chalices.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the Chalices.
